summary.purpose: S1 (second-pass audit): rules.md step 4 fixes each anti-communist faction at 22 organization pieces as the hard build maximum; no limit existed anywhere in code. Red Army limit is a flat 40 per user decision on 2026-07-11 (rulebook formula is 8×players +8 with Taiwan; deliberately overridden). Enforcement lives in can_develop_in_town (single funnel for every build path and UI eligibility list), with clear error messages in build_organization, plus a supply check when moving a shared organization owned by another player (ownership transfer = net +1). Own-org moves and dissolves are unaffected; dissolving frees supply.
